info.name: ZCanopy Mobile - Matched Non-Web Endpoints
info.description:
NON-WEB (/mobile) endpoints of the ZCanopy API Gateway that have a corresponding WEB endpoint used by zcanopy-storefront and/or zcanopy-dashboard.

HOW THIS WAS BUILT
- Web endpoint inventory extracted from: zcanopy-storefront (src/lib/api.ts, src/app/**) and zcanopy-dashboard (lib/api.ts).
- Route inventory extracted from: zcanopy-microservices/apps/api-gateway/src/app/*.controller.ts (global prefix: 'api').
- Included: only non-web routes that match a web endpoint semantically (same downstream gRPC method).
- EXCLUDED: non-web routes with no web counterpart (e.g. /admin/*, /brokers/fcm-token, /listings/get-item-details, /payment/get_payment_status, /payment/access-token).
- Each request description states the web endpoint(s) it replaces.

AUTH NOTES
- JWT bearer routes: send Authorization: Bearer {{token}} (collection level).
- Session-scoped routes: send x-session-id: {{sessionToken}} or pass sessionToken in the body/query as documented per request.
- Gateway guard only reads the 'Authorization: Bearer' header (apps/api-gateway/src/app/jwt-auth.guard.ts).

item.name: 01 Auth & Session
item.description: Login, token refresh, password reset, anonymous/validated sessions and user-record routes that replace the web /web/auth/* and /web/session/* endpoints.

Forwards AuthService 'Login' with type forced to 'broker'.

Matches web endpoint: POST /web/auth/login (zcanopy-dashboard).
WARNING: AuthController.login() overrides any incoming type with type:'admin'.
Matches web endpoint: POST /web/auth/broker/google (zcanopy-dashboard).

Matches web endpoint: POST /web/auth/broker/setup (zcanopy-dashboard).
Note: when brokerBrandName is present the gateway appends it to deviceId as 'deviceId,brokerBrandName'.
Matches web endpoint: POST /web/auth/refresh.

Forwards BrokerService 'ForgotPassword'.
Matches web endpoint: POST /auth/forgot-password/otp/verify (zcanopy-dashboard).
Matches web endpoint: POST /auth/forgot-password/reset (zcanopy-dashboard).
Matches storefront endpoint: POST /customer/session (called directly by zcanopy-storefront src/lib/api.ts ensureAnonymousSession()).

Matches web endpoint: POST /web/session/validate (zcanopy-storefront).
The web route reads the x-session-id header; this non-web route takes the token in the body as sessionID or sessionToken. Same downstream AuthService 'ValidateBrokerSession'.
Matches web endpoint: POST /web/session/validate (zcanopy-storefront). Duplicate non-web alias of /gate-way/validate-session.

Matches web endpoint: POST /web/customer/logout (zcanopy-storefront customer.logout wrapper).
Forwards AuthService 'RevokeCustomerSession' with sessionToken = userID.

Matches web endpoint: POST /web/broker/profile (zcanopy-dashboard).
The web route resolves broker.id first and sends it as userId; send the broker record id here.

Matches web endpoint: POST /web/broker/change-password (zcanopy-dashboard).
The web route verifies the OTP server-side then calls this same route. For mobile, first call 'Get Change Password OTP' in folder 12, then update the field here.
Matches web endpoint: POST /web/broker/account/delete/request-otp (zcanopy-dashboard).
Matches web endpoint: POST /web/broker/account/delete/request-otp (zcanopy-dashboard). Duplicate non-web alias; accepts userId, userID or email.
Matches web endpoint: GET /web/broker/subscription (zcanopy-dashboard).

item.name: 02 Customer
item.description:
Non-web customer routes replacing the web /web/customer/* endpoints (zcanopy-storefront) and /web/public/* browse endpoints.
Routes reading a session use the x-session-id header; routes deriving the customer from a JWT are JWT-guarded.

request.description:
Matches storefront endpoint: POST /customer/forgot-password/otp/send (called directly by zcanopy-storefront).
Forwards CustomerService 'ForgotPassword'. Same body as the dashboard's broker variant in folder 01.
Matches storefront endpoint: POST /customer/forgot-password/otp/verify (called directly by zcanopy-storefront).
Matches storefront endpoint: POST /customer/forgot-password/reset (called directly by zcanopy-storefront).

Matches web endpoints: GET /web/customer/explorer, GET /web/customer/video-tours, GET /web/customer/all-properties, GET /web/public/explorer.
Same downstream PropertyService 'GetCustomerProperties'. NOTE: this non-web route only accepts page, limit, lat, lng, radiusKm and propertyType - it does NOT accept brokerCode, brokerBrandName, minPrice, maxPrice, subCounty, district, fromDate or toDate like the web explorer does. Use /listings/search (folder 04) for those filters.
Matches web endpoint: GET /web/customer/properties?propertyId=... (zcanopy-storefront customer.getPropertyDetails).
Matches web endpoint: GET /web/customer/broker/{brokerCode}/properties (zcanopy-storefront brokerPropertiesByCode).

Matches web endpoints: GET /web/public/search?q=... and GET /web/public/explorer (zcanopy-storefront).
Same downstream PropertyService 'SearchProperties'. Accepts both 'q' (as the web route sends) and 'query'.

Matches web endpoint: POST /web/customer/search/record (zcanopy-storefront recordSearch).
The gateway resolves customerId from the JWT; send sessionToken for anonymous search logging.
Matches web endpoint: GET /web/customer/searches?page=&limit= (zcanopy-storefront getCustomerSearches). limit is capped at 50.
Matches web endpoint: GET /web/customer/searches?page=&limit= (zcanopy-storefront). Use this variant when the client authenticates with a session token instead of a JWT.
Matches web endpoint: POST /web/customer/favorites/toggle (zcanopy-storefront toggleFavorite).
Matches web endpoint: GET /web/customer/favorites?page=&limit= (zcanopy-storefront getCustomerFavorites). limit is capped at 50.
Matches web endpoint: POST /web/customer/comments (zcanopy-storefront addComment).
Matches web endpoint: GET /web/customer/properties/{propertyId}/comments?page=&limit= (zcanopy-storefront getPropertyComments). Public - no auth.

Matches web endpoints: POST /web/customer/bookings (zcanopy-storefront createBooking, zcanopy-dashboard createBooking).
JWT-guarded; customerId is taken from the token.
Matches web endpoint: GET /web/customer/bookings?page=&limit= (zcanopy-storefront getBookings).

Matches web endpoint: POST /web/customer/bookings/retrieve (zcanopy-storefront find-booking page).
The gateway maps 'code' -> transactionCode and 'phoneNumber' -> customerPhone.
Matches web endpoints: POST /web/customer/bookings/retrieve-by-code (zcanopy-storefront find-booking and bookings/retrieve pages).

item.name: 03 Properties
item.description: Non-web property CRUD replacing the web /web/broker/properties/* (zcanopy-dashboard) and /web/public/properties* (zcanopy-storefront) endpoints. The whole controller is JWT-guarded.

request.description:
Matches web endpoints: GET /web/public/properties (zcanopy-dashboard), GET /web/broker/properties (zcanopy-dashboard), GET /web/broker/properties?id=...
The non-web route forwards the whole query object unfiltered to PropertyService 'GetProperties'.

Matches web endpoint: POST /web/broker/properties (zcanopy-dashboard createProperty).
Unlike the web route, which overwrites brokersUniqueCode from the JWT, the non-web route requires brokersUniqueCode in the body.

item.name: 04 Listings (public browse & search)
item.description: Unguarded non-web listing routes that replace the web /web/public/* explorer, search and property-info endpoints.

request.description:
Matches web endpoints: GET /web/public/search?q=... (zcanopy-storefront) and GET /web/public/explorer.
This is the closest non-web equivalent to the web explorer: it accepts the full filter set (subCounty, district, minPrice, maxPrice, lat, lng, radiusKm) that /customer/properties drops.
Matches web endpoint: GET /web/broker/properties (zcanopy-dashboard brokerProperties). Public; 'user_id' is the broker code.

Matches web endpoints: GET /web/public/property-info?id=&brokerCode= (zcanopy-storefront propertyDetails) and GET /web/broker/properties/{id} (zcanopy-dashboard).
Both 'id' and 'brokerCode' are required; returns { success, property }.
Matches web endpoints: GET /web/public/properties and GET /web/broker/properties. Legacy pass-through of the whole query to PropertyService 'GetProperties'.

Matches web endpoints: GET /web/customer/video-tours, GET /web/customer/all-properties, GET /web/public/explorer (zcanopy-storefront) - geo-radius variants.
NOTE: the gateway maps a 'long' query key onto 'lng' before forwarding.

item.name: 05 Brokers (JWT bearer)
item.description: Non-web broker routes replacing the web /web/broker/* endpoints (zcanopy-dashboard) and /web/public/brokers (zcanopy-storefront). The whole controller is JWT-guarded and derives brokerCode from the token where noted.

request.description: Matches web endpoint: GET /web/public/brokers?limit=200 (zcanopy-storefront getBrokers filter dropdown).

query.description: BrokerService defaults to 10, which truncates the dropdown

request.description:
Matches web endpoint: GET /web/public/brokers (zcanopy-storefront). Search variant by title or username.

KNOWN GATEWAY ROUTE BUG: BrokerController declares @Get(':id') (line 34) BEFORE @Get('search') (line 116), so NestJS matches '/brokers/search' as getBrokerById with id='search' and the 'q' query is ignored. Until the route order is fixed, use 'Get All Brokers' above or GET /users/get-user-by-email?email=... to look up a broker.
Matches web endpoint: GET /web/broker/profile (zcanopy-dashboard brokerProfile).
Matches web endpoint: POST /web/broker/profile (zcanopy-dashboard updateProfile). brokerCode is taken from the token; this is the direct alternative to POST /users/save-user-info in folder 01.

Matches web endpoint: GET /web/broker/dashboard (zcanopy-dashboard).
The web route composes broker + properties + bookings + wallet; this route returns the broker service's own dashboard aggregate.
Matches web endpoint: POST /web/broker/subscribe (zcanopy-dashboard brokerSubscribe). brokerCode comes from the token.

Matches web endpoint: POST /web/broker/withdraw (zcanopy-dashboard brokerWithdraw). brokerCode comes from the token.

item.name: 06 Broker Public Auth
item.description: Unguarded non-web broker registration and OTP routes. These paths are already non-web and are called directly by zcanopy-storefront and zcanopy-dashboard.

request.description: Matches endpoints already called by both web clients: POST /broker/register (zcanopy-storefront registerBroker, zcanopy-dashboard webApi.registerBroker).
Matches endpoints already called by both web clients: POST /broker/otp/send.
Matches endpoints already called by both web clients: POST /broker/otp/verify.

item.name: 07 Broker Session
item.description: Session-scoped non-web broker routes replacing the web /web/broker/logout and /web/broker/account/delete endpoints. These live outside the JWT guard because the mobile broker app authenticates with a session token.

request.description: Matches web endpoint: POST /web/broker/logout (zcanopy-dashboard brokerLogout).
Matches web endpoint: POST /web/broker/account/delete/request-otp (zcanopy-dashboard).
Matches web endpoint: POST /web/broker/account/delete (zcanopy-dashboard brokerDeleteAccount).

item.name: 08 Notifications
item.description: Non-web notification routes replacing the web /web/broker/notifications endpoints (zcanopy-dashboard). Session-scoped; the notification service derives the owning brokerCode server-side.

request.description:
Matches web endpoint: GET /web/broker/notifications (zcanopy-dashboard brokerNotifications).
The web route sends brokerCode + page/limit/type/read; this route also accepts sessionToken.
Matches web endpoint: POST /web/broker/notifications/mark-read (zcanopy-dashboard). Pass { all: true } to mark everything, { id } for one, or { ids } for many.

item.name: 09 Subscriptions
item.description: Non-web subscription routes replacing the web /web/broker/subscription* endpoints (zcanopy-dashboard).

request.description:
Matches web endpoint: GET /web/broker/subscription/packages (zcanopy-dashboard subscriptionPackages).
Also reachable as POST /subscriptions/cancel's sibling route; the dashboard's own brokerCancelSubscription wrapper already targets /subscriptions/cancel.

Matches web endpoints: POST /subscriptions/cancel (zcanopy-dashboard webApi.brokerCancelSubscription) and POST /web/broker/account/delete (zcanopy-dashboard). Same downstream BrokerService 'UnsubscribeBroker'.

item.name: 10 Payments
item.description: Non-web payment routes replacing the web /web/customer/transactions and /web/customer/invoices endpoints (zcanopy-storefront).

request.description:
Matches web endpoints: GET /web/customer/transactions?page=&limit= and GET /web/customer/invoices?page=&limit= (zcanopy-storefront).
Both web routes forward the same PaymentService 'GetTransactions' call, so a mobile client can use either shape here.

query.description: The web customer routes pass the customerId in this field

request.description: Matches web endpoints: GET /web/customer/transactions and GET /web/customer/invoices (zcanopy-storefront). Unguarded legacy variant; 'user_id' is the customer/broker id.

Matches web endpoint: POST /web/customer/transactions/initiate (zcanopy-storefront customer.initiateTransaction).
Mobile variant forwards PaymentService 'ProcessCustomerPayment' with phoneNumber, amount and userId.

item.name: 11 Bookings
item.description: Non-web booking-listing routes replacing the web /web/broker/bookings and /web/customer/bookings endpoints.

request.description: Matches web endpoint: GET /web/broker/bookings (zcanopy-dashboard brokerBookings). Unguarded legacy variant; 'user_id' is the broker code.
Matches web endpoint: GET /web/customer/bookings?page=&limit= (zcanopy-storefront). Session-token variant, fixed at page 1 / limit 50.

item.name: 12 Gate-way (legacy mobile)
item.description: Legacy non-web /gate-way routes used by the mobile apps, replacing the web endpoints listed per request.

request.description:
Matches web endpoints: POST /web/broker/change-password/request-otp (zcanopy-dashboard).
Send 'email' for an email OTP or 'phoneNumber' for an SMS OTP.

Matches web endpoint: PUT /web/broker/bookings/{id}/status with status 'Rejected' (zcanopy-dashboard).
PARTIAL MATCH: there is no non-web route for the general Approved/Rejected status update - only the decline path exists. The web route forwards UpdateBookingStatus; this one forwards DeclineBooking with the transaction code.

Matches web endpoint: POST /web/broker/account/delete (zcanopy-dashboard).
Hard-delete variant (BrokerService 'DeleteBrokerAccount'); use /brokers/unsubscribe-user for the OTP-confirmed soft delete.

Matches web endpoint: POST /web/broker/subscribe (zcanopy-dashboard).
Legacy variant; the tier is read from 'package' or 'tier' and the broker from 'userId', 'userID' or 'brokerId'.

Matches web endpoint: GET /web/public/locations and the storefront's location capture.
Same downstream PropertyService 'ResolveLocationName'. NOTE: reads the longitude from the 'long' query key.
Matches web endpoint: GET /web/broker/notifications (zcanopy-dashboard). Legacy pass-through; prefer /notifications/get_notifications (folder 08), which maps fields explicitly.
Matches web endpoints: GET /web/public/properties/featured (zcanopy-dashboard webApi.featuredProperties) and GET /web/public/property-info (zcanopy-storefront propertyDetails fallback).

item.name: 14 Upload
item.description: Non-web DigitalOcean Spaces upload routes. Already non-web and called directly by both web clients.

request.description:
Matches endpoints already called by both web clients: POST /upload/presign (zcanopy-storefront getUploadPresignedUrl, zcanopy-dashboard getUploadPresignedUrl).
Returns uploadUrl / key / publicUrl. PUT the raw file bytes to uploadUrl with Content-Type: <contentType>, then store publicUrl.

Matches endpoints already called by both web clients: POST /upload/proxy?folder=... (zcanopy-storefront uploadToSpacesViaProxy, zcanopy-dashboard uploadToSpacesViaProxy).
Use this multipart fallback when the direct Spaces PUT is blocked by CORS. Returns { key, publicUrl }.
